property_summary: For every caller address, calling owned() on the reference contract does not succeed unless the caller is the owner (onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner); the mutant inverts this and allows non-owners to call owned(), so there exist callers for which the mutant's behavior (successful call) differs from the reference.
change_summary: Replace the require in onlyOwner with require(msg.sender != owner) reversing the guard so only non-owners can call, allowing owned() to be called by others and potentially change owner when owned() modifies state.
